note: Verified Elite Tempo presets, hand-timed from video to 1/100s. ratio/total/beat-times all compute from start/top/impact.

presets.story: Tiger Woods, 2000 Memorial Tournament, which he won just before his historic U.S. Open. Captured from a flawless second-round 63, the peak of the legendary 2000 swing. A decisive 2.82:1 over 1.13 seconds.

Tiger Woods, 2000 Open Championship at St. Andrews: an eight-shot win at 24 that completed the career Grand Slam. Off the tee, a long, patient 0.82s backswing winding into a 0.22s release, a towering 3.69:1 over 1.05 seconds.

Rory McIlroy, 2014 PGA Championship at Valhalla: the hole-16 driver he capped with a club twirl and a fist pump on his way to the title. Explosive: a full 0.63s backswing into a whip-quick 0.26s release, a clean 2.45:1 over 0.89 seconds.

Rory McIlroy, 2010 Wells Fargo Championship: his first PGA Tour win, the day he shot a course-record 62 at Quail Hollow. This long iron into the par-5 15th is one of the purest swings of his career: a smooth 2.51:1 over 0.88 seconds, balanced and unforced.
Adam Scott, 2022, driver: 0.70s back and 0.24s down, a 2.9:1 tempo over 0.94 seconds.

Scottie Scheffler, 2024 Players Championship: a wedge from the fairway on the par-5 4th in Sunday’s final round that he holed for eagle, propelling him to back-to-back titles at TPC Sawgrass. Compact and ruthless: a 0.74s backswing into a 0.28s release, a 2.60:1 over 1.02 seconds.

Cameron Smith, 2022 Open Championship at St. Andrews: the 150th Open, won with a Sunday charge of birdies on the Old Course. This stroke on the famous Road Hole 17th in the final round shows the smooth, quiet putting tempo that carried him to the Claret Jug: a soft 2.05:1 over 0.78 seconds.

Cameron Young has one of the most distinctive tempos in golf: an unusually long, patient backswing. Off the tee at the 2025 Ryder Cup, a huge 1.19s backswing unwinds into a 0.28s release, a steep 4.26:1 over 1.47 seconds.

Jordan Spieth, 2017 Travelers Championship at TPC River Highlands. On the first hole of sudden death, the 18th, he holed a greenside bunker shot to win, then flung the wedge skyward as Michael Greller raced in to celebrate. The tempo is all snap: a compact 0.62s backswing into a 0.24s release, a crisp 2.58:1 over 0.86 seconds.

Phil Mickelson, 2013 Scottish Open at Castle Stuart. On the 18th in sudden death, he played a soft pitch to set up the win over Branden Grace, the springboard to his Open Championship victory the very next week at Muirfield. A languid 0.52s backswing into a 0.26s release, a smooth 2.02:1 over 0.77 seconds.

Tiger Woods, 1999 Memorial Tournament at Muirfield Village, a win on Jack’s course in the middle of a dominant run. In Sunday’s final round he chipped in on the 14th, all soft hands and feel. A patient 0.49s backswing into a 0.24s release, a gentle 2.06:1 over 0.73 seconds.

Tiger Woods, 2000 PGA Championship at Valhalla. On the 72nd hole he rolled in a slick par putt to tie Bob May and force the playoff he would go on to win, his third major of that historic 2000 season. A compact 0.54s backswing into a 0.18s release, a quick 2.98:1 over 0.72 seconds.

Tiger Woods, 2007 PGA Championship at Southern Hills, his thirteenth major, won in the brutal Tulsa heat. His second shot into the 7th was a swooping draw, the shot shape he could summon at will that week. A full 0.67s backswing into a 0.21s release, a powerful 3.19:1 over 0.88 seconds.
